slides.title: Rules for using control material
bullets: 1. Before use study the supplied instructions (the passport) carefully.
2. Even if the instructions say that the material is free of hepatitis and HIV antigens, handle it with great care.
3. To prepare for work use the instructions recommended by the manufacturer.
4. Open the vial very carefully so as not to spill; measure the solvent exactly.

slides.title: Rules for using control material
bullets: 5. After the vial is tightly closed mix it well without foaming and observe the dissolving time.
